fact: BIIC and ADPME launched the FAEN programme to finance start-ups holding the 'start-up' label in seed phase (under 3 years) and growth-stage SMEs.

Decree No. 2023-095 of 22 March 2023, signed by the President on the digital minister's proposal, sets how the 'start-up' label is granted to micro, small and medium firms, with labelled start-ups given the tax incentives of the General Tax Code.
system: Décret n° 2023-095 portant modalités d'octroi du label start-up

fact: La Marina BJ reports that Benin's startup label rests on decree 2023-095 and that article 147 of the tax code already gives labelled startups two years of corporate tax and payroll levy exemption, then 50% in year three.
La Marina BJ reports the first startup label session, 2 to 12 December 2024, drew 95 applications and labelled fifteen firms, with the tax exemption applying to labelled startups.

La Nation reports that ADPME and BIIC launched the digital entrepreneurship support fund FAEN on 1 October 2025 at a ceremony attended by labelled start-ups (jeunes pousses labellisees); no investment is named.
